accuracy.evidence: Checked NC Y3 Plants investigate water transport within plants; celery-dye pathway matches roots→xylem/stem tubes→leaves model.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked traps: leaves drink soil with no stem path; flowers as path start; ignoring that a block/crush stops flow above.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked flagxylem: rising dye level, stem tubes, block/wilt; not flagpfunc (part jobs), flagsprout (needs), or flagplant (name parts).

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked: learner shows roots drinking, opens tubes, reaches leaves, blocks stem to dry top, orders path, spots leaf-drinks-soil myth.

predictions.evidence: Checked tempting wrongs on entry point, tube role, celery meaning, block effect, path order, and leaf-drinks-soil myth.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked why() splits flower-start, leaf-drinks-soil, food-vs-transport, and reverse-order / block slips.

readability.evidence: Checked ages 7–8 kid lines use roots/tubes/leaves/block; adult names NC Y3 and celery-dye within family bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked every sentence teaches the water path, a block consequence, or the celery model.

mobile.evidence: Checked young plant UI with large lbtn twins and canvas taps; usable near 390 px.

accessibility.evidence: Checked drink/tube/block buttons plus canvas taps; live aria-label; challenge aria-live; axe expected clean.

sources: UK NC 2013 Science Y3 Plants: investigate the way in which water is transported within plants
